requests.description: Deletes a version and all of its content. The returned operation will complete once the version has been deleted.

requests.description: Directly uploads an Apt artifact. The returned Operation will complete once the resources are uploaded. Package, Version, and File resources are created based on the imported artifact. Imported artifacts that conflict with existing resources are ignored.

requests.note: Replace {{ARTIFACT_REGISTRY_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
